evidence: Carries the Mining label, modifies BlockTemplateManager, updates interfaces::Mining and mining.capnp, and adds test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py.
rationale: Enables external IPC mining clients like Stratum v2 template providers to track and manage memory from evicted mempool transactions pinned by active block templates. As noted in issue #33899 and demonstrated in stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63, external clients can hold templates indefinitely, making visibility into non-mempool memory essential for preventing unbounded memory growth.
